task: Non-CBC baseline inputs -> RDW and hemoglobin proxies -> public-use five-year all-cause mortality

weights.stored_weight_column: WTMEC2YR / 2; a four-year-period convenience column, not an eight-year population weight
weights.training: all g, B, M, P fits and nested fits use current pool weights normalized to current fitting-sample mean 1
weights.pool_definition_for_cv: K is the number of planned two-year cycles in the current development pool, not inferred anew from a sparse fold
weights.proxy_selection: weighted normalized measurement MSE; aggregate folds by held-out total weight
weights.primary_evaluation: weighted Brier in the eligible analytic cohort; full test MEC design frame retained for domain variance
weights.selection_bias: weights and domain Taylor variance do not automatically correct CBC missingness or linkage ineligibility

preprocessing.numeric_missing_indicators: one fixed indicator for each numeric X, including if all training values are observed
preprocessing.categorical_encoding: one-hot, fit training categories only, handle_unknown=ignore
preprocessing.X_standard_scaler: ordinary unweighted training mean and population variance; fitting losses still use survey weights
preprocessing.proxy_outputs: inverse-transform to original Z units before any downstream query

proxy.selection_metric: mean of the two weighted MSEs divided by their current-training Z variances
proxy.target_mean: sum(w*z)/sum(w) in each current fitting subset
proxy.target_variance: sum(w*(z-weighted_mean)^2)/sum(w); weighted population variance, no ddof correction
proxy.cv_aggregation: within each fold average the two validation weighted MSE / fold-training target variance values; combine fold scores weighted by each validation fold total weight
proxy.split_rule: shuffle unique groups with the recorded seed, partition into three folds without outcome-based retries

downstream.selection_dataset: 2005-2006 validation, after fitting candidates only in 2003-2004
downstream.tie_breaker: earlier candidate in this ordered list

spline_defaults.numeric_columns: all continuous X plus the two measured or proxy Z when present

downstream.extra_test_fits: none: report the three selected procedures, not all candidates as competing final-test winners

statistics.mean_and_contrast_variance: stratified PSU Taylor linearization with analytic-domain zero contributions
statistics.interval_scope: pointwise, conditional on fitted models and public-use measurements/outcomes
statistics.df: number of PSUs containing analytic-domain observations minus number of strata containing analytic-domain observations
statistics.ratio_method: unpenalized Fieller confidence set using the same joint design covariance and t critical value
secondary_metrics: weighted observed and predicted event rates
endpoint_metrics: weighted MAE improvement over development-mean prediction

fixed_sensitivities.description: unweighted Brier and contrasts on identical final-test predictions; descriptive only
same fitted predictions in the final-test 40-79 subdomain, retaining the full test design frame

scope.manuscript_integration: draft a standalone new subsection and exact insertion map; do not overwrite current main manuscript
scope.scientific_stop_rule: complete and report all predeclared routes regardless of positive or negative gain
scope.panel_expansion: keep RDW and hemoglobin; no albumin or creatinine in V2
scope.public_repository: allowlisted source, protocol and official download scripts only; no raw, participant-level data, predictions, trained models, caches, or unpublished manuscript context

measurement_transport.interpretation: later-period fixed-model substitution under a documented CBC instrument transition

pre_model_diagnostics.measurements: per-cycle weighted ECDF, mean, population SD, min, p05, p25, median, p75, p95, max
pre_model_diagnostics.quantiles: inverse weighted empirical CDF, no interpolation
pre_model_diagnostics.additional_followup_counts: death 54-66 total, alive 54-66, unknown five-year status 54-66; overlapping descriptive categories are labeled
pre_model_diagnostics.boundary_population: otherwise eligible before five-year ascertainability exclusion
pre_model_diagnostics.perturbed_record_count: not identifiable from the public file

protocol_record.first_study_fit_includes: proxy fits, downstream fits, and pilot or smoke fits on actual study data
protocol_record.record_description: versioned analysis plan recorded before model fitting; not automatically a formal preregistration
protocol_record.repository_visibility: public or private as designated by the author; record actual visibility and verification access
protocol_record.permitted_before_remote_record: implementation, environment setup, schema checks, artificial-data interface checks, provided descriptive audits, code-only export

author_override.instruction: The author directed that the local analysis proceed before repository publication.
author_override.supersedes: remote protocol record before any study-data model fit
author_override.scope: execute complete V2 experiment locally now; later upload only to an author-designated repository
